relations: Maroon locomotive advances rightward on left track toward the stacked-block wall spanning the junction.
While the wall holds upright, the train slips out of view behind it.
As the wall leans and topples forward, its rows separate and scatter across the right track.
The train reappears on the right, moving through the tumbling blocks and exiting the frame.
caption: The video depicts a tabletop model scene on a green textured surface against a white backdrop. Multiple light-wood train tracks meet at a junction, a small artificial evergreen tree stands to the right, and a vertical wall of stacked pale wooden blocks is built across the junction. A maroon toy locomotive on the left track progresses rightward toward the wall, which remains upright through the early frames. As the train advances it slips out of view behind the wall, hidden while the structure still holds. The wall then begins to lean and topple forward toward the camera and the right-hand track. Its rows of blocks separate and fall. As the pile collapses, the maroon train reappears on the right side, moving rightward along the track and passing through the tumbling blocks as the wall's remains give way. The locomotive continues and exits the frame on the right. The blocks settle into a scattered, overlapping pile lying across the right track and foreground, while the tree, backdrop and ground remain fixed throughout, indicating an essentially stationary viewpoint.
